name-01.translation: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

corpus-01.translation: Teacher, I really did my homework—but my dog ate it.

corpus-02.translation: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lyrics!

corpus-03.translation: Nah, not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

context-01.translation: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

corpus-07.translation: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-09.translation: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.translation: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

corpus-05.translation: It's just hahaha so random, like who even gets this question

errors.note: “太抽象了”指内容离谱、难以理解，译成“so random”改变了含义，偏向“随意、无厘头”。

errors.span: like who even gets this question
errors.note: “谁懂啊”是口语化的共鸣表达（“谁能理解/有同感”），译成“who even gets this question”变成“谁能看懂这个问题”，语气和含义都偏了。

corpus-11.translation: Fine. I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap once I'm back in China.

corpus-12.translation: That short? Hit a creative block?

corpus-06.translation: I think it's true—I even came across some leaked videos from his concert.

errors.note: “好像是真的”表示说话人不太确定，而“I think it's true”语气更肯定，略微改变了不确定的语气。

corpus-08.translation: Besides, he's got that honest, down-to-earth vibe that makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.

corpus-19.translation: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-14.translation: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — which one wins?

corpus-15.translation: Just look at that fake-deep expression on his face—you can tell something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on Moments every day.

corpus-17.translation: Nah, I'm not dating—these days love comes with a price tag.

corpus-21.translation: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-20.translation: Hakimi, north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

errors.note: “哈基米”是网络梗/音译词（常指可爱小动物或梗用语），并非人名“Hakimi”，音译为人名会误导观众。
“南北绿豆”是梗式无意义搭配，直译为 north-south mung beans 生硬且丢失梗味，观众难以理解其含义。

errors.span: I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk
errors.note: “憋出内伤”指强忍情绪到内伤，译文只表达“忍笑”，语气和夸张程度略弱，但基本可理解。

corpus-18.translation: Not dating you. Go play by yourself.

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不相处/不交往”，但更可能是“不处（对象）”的简略拒绝；译成“Not dating you”把拒绝交往具体化为恋爱关系，且“you”是增译，原文无宾语，属误译加增译，会误导观众。
“自己玩去”是带不耐烦语气的口语驱赶，译文偏直译、语气略生硬，可更口语化如“Go play on your own.”

corpus-27.translation: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-22.translation: Last night I stayed up watching your livestream and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.translation: Rushed out the door and accidentally brought the rag to work instead of a towel.

corpus-28.translation: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-24.translation: Not dating. This drama's too big to even process.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，但译文“Not dating”在此语境下被误读为对“瓜”的回应，导致语义完全错位，观众会得到错误信息。

errors.span: This drama's too big to even process.
errors.note: “瓜太大了啃不动”指八卦信息量太大难以消化，译文用“drama”偏向“戏剧/闹剧”，且“too big to process”改变了“啃不动”（难以消化/接受）的比喻，意思有明显偏差。

corpus-29.translation: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better suited for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-32.translation: I'm already running a fever—please, ladies, just spare me.

corpus-31.translation: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, everyone's got at least one mortifying story about buying pads!

corpus-39.translation: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-33.translation: Watch Gen Z chat in their own coded slang

errors.note: “00后”指2000年后出生的一代，与“Gen Z”（通常约1997–2012年出生）并不完全等同，属于近似替换而非准确对应。
“火星文”特指一种刻意怪异、难以辨认的网络文字/符号写法，译成“coded slang”（编码俚语）弱化了其“火星文”这一特定网络用语的意味。

corpus-34.translation: I keep getting interrupted by messages at work and can't focus. Any tips for being more productive?

corpus-38.translation: I was scrolling through videos and saw this super-huge jianbing guozi (Chinese crepe) made by a Shandong street vendor lady, and suddenly I got curious—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the whole country?

corpus-41.translation: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

corpus-40.translation: I can't even—this is too much good news all at once!

errors.note: “I can't even—”是网络流行语，语气偏轻佻随意，与原文“我不行了”表达承受不住、招架不住的口语感叹略有出入，但基本可接受。

errors.span: this is too much good news all at once!
errors.note: 原文只说“幸福来得太突然”，并未明确是“好消息”，译文增补了“good news”，属轻微增译，但整体意思一致。

corpus-44.translation: I'm done—I've worked so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-42.translation: Hahaha I can't even, netizens these days are just too creative

corpus-47.translation: Can you stop dragging me into games all the time?

ctx-01.translation: Don't worry, I've got my lines down pat.

corpus-48.translation: I can't take it anymore—this is way too cute!

corpus-49.translation: I can't take it anymore—I know everything, I've grinded so hard I'm going bald.

corpus-45.translation: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called, uh, Xiaochao Team, right? I remember it all!

ctx-02.translation: She said she won't be home for dinner tonight.

ctx-c02.translation: Keep it dry, or I'll have to change into a new pair again.

ctx-c05.translation: The power of six family wallets—their family must be made of money.

errors.span: their family must be made of money
errors.note: “家里有矿”是网络俚语，意为家里非常有钱；译成“made of money”可以接受，但“their family”略微改变了主语，原文指的是说话对象/被谈论的人家，而不是“他们”的家。

m-004.translation: There's always someone who keeps quoting movie lines when we play poker.

m-001.translation: Let you in on a secret—search "zhuliren" and raise a Douyin virtual pet to get your fix.

ctx-c38.translation: Sometimes his shooting touch is so insane the crowd suspects he's hacking—the chat just floods with "666" and nobody even bothers to boo.

errors.note: 原文“直接666刷屏”指弹幕/评论刷屏，译成“the chat”把语境限定为聊天，略有偏差但可接受。

m-003.translation: Excuse me, did you just crawl out of the starter village?

errors.note: 原文“刚出来”没有“爬”的意思，crawl out of 属于增译，略微改变了语气。
“新手村”是游戏术语，通常译作 newbie village / beginner's village，starter village 不够地道。

m-002.translation: Suggest taking your parents to a store to try how smoothly the system runs. For storage, go with the 12+256G version.

errors.note: “内存”指运行内存（RAM），不是存储空间，译成 storage 会误导观众以为说的是存储容量。
规格写法宜统一为 12+256GB，G 单独使用不够规范。

m-005.translation: Seeing a little dog by the roadside wagging its tail at me

errors.span: Seeing a little dog by the roadside wagging its tail at me
errors.note: 这是悬垂分词短语，没有主句，作为独立字幕显得不完整、不自然。

ctx-c57.translation: LMAO, that last line needed more punch — you got the boss completely worked up. When us socially anxious folks snap, we go hard.

errors.note: “加点啊”指给最后那句台词加点（内容/料），译成“需要更有冲击力”略有偏移，但大意接近。

errors.span: you got the boss completely worked up
errors.note: “整红温啦”是网络用语，指把老板弄得脸红/破防，译文“worked up”基本传达，但“红温”的脸红/破防意味有所弱化。

m-006.translation: Guess what? Our school cafeteria was free today!

errors.note: 原文“居然免费”指食堂今天提供免费餐食，而“was free”易被理解为食堂本身不收费/免费开放，意思有偏差。

m-008.translation: I'm not obligated to tell you~ It's my little secret.

m-007.translation: Hahahaha I can totally picture it!

m-010.translation: Recently I've noticed a lot of my friends are into stand-up comedy—even my parents have started watching it.

m-009.translation: Can you become a pro just by shitposting? Are you the plagiarism police or something?

m-011.translation: I just found out my mom gave away my prized figurine collection.

m-012.translation: I have to get through this document today.

m-013.translation: Some people say I'm so fair-skinned I look mixed.

m-017.translation: This streamer's story is way too crazy.

m-016.translation: Remember to bring a lightweight, big cloth bag for all your stuff—backpacks aren't practical on the beach.

m-014.translation: Last night while gaming, I just found out that holding this button unleashes your ultimate.

errors.note: 原文未指明“你的”，加 your 属于轻微增译，且与字幕中说话人视角略有出入。

m-015.translation: Bestie, I can't even—this tea is too juicy.

m-018.translation: This game's difficulty is way too ridiculous, isn't it?

errors.note: 原文是陈述句的感叹，没有反问，添加反义疑问句属于轻微增译，改变了语气。

m-019.translation: I really can't take it anymore—my stomach's about to explode.

m-020.translation: And that whole "so what? what're you gonna do about it?" thing—listening to it makes me wanna crap. It's as brainwashing as a virus.

errors.span: so what? what're you gonna do about it?
errors.note: “那咋了又能怎”是口语化的“那又怎样/你能怎样”，译文拆成两个问句并加了“what're you gonna do about it”，略有增译和语气强化，但基本达意。
“洗脑程度”指歌曲上口、挥之不去，用“brainwashing”偏字面且语义偏负面（思想控制），口语中更常说“catchy/stuck in my head”，略显生硬。

m-022.translation: Li Zongheng's performance here is absolutely amazing—he could easily make it onto the big stage.

m-026.translation: So now every time I just tell him, 'Then deal with it.' Let him get a taste of what it's like to have grievances he can't voice.

m-023.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? I'll go catch up on the lessons right now.

errors.span: Why didn't you say so earlier?
errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语化的感叹，译成完整疑问句略显生硬，缺少原文的惊讶/抱怨语气。

m-027.translation: What do you guys even mean by "yes-man"?

m-024.translation: Everyone here must be crying from the anxiety by now!

errors.span: must be crying from the anxiety by now
errors.note: “急哭”是夸张的口语说法，指极度焦急/抓狂，并非真的哭泣；译成“crying from the anxiety”把比喻坐实，改变了原意。

errors.span: Everyone here must be crying from the anxiety by now!
errors.note: 语气过于书面、冗长，不像字幕口语；原文是带调侃意味的感叹句。

m-028.translation: Your pronunciation is so weirdly catchy.

errors.note: “魔性”指发音怪异、洗脑或让人上头，而“catchy”多用于形容旋律朗朗上口，这里用“weirdly catchy”表达“魔性”有偏差，容易让观众误解为“好听、容易记住”。

m-029.translation: Made me waste so much time.

m-025.translation: Jumping straight into the lesson at frame zero, huh? Not even a warm-up. This coach must be a retired esports player.

errors.note: “0帧教学”是网络用语，指视频一开头就进入教学、没有任何铺垫；“at frame zero”过于直译，英文观众难以理解这层含义。
“转行”指改行做教练，并未说明是退役；“retired”添加了原文没有的信息，宜译为“switched careers from being an esports player”。

m-032.translation: I've noticed this guy keeps marking my water bottle lately.

m-031.translation: Haven't you noticed he always does a little twirl on the red carpet at every big event?

m-035.translation: The PPT the teacher showed in class was hilarious.

m-037.translation: Let me show you guys a trick.

m-034.translation: I can't stand this group anymore.

errors.note: “这群”指这群人/这个地方的这群人，译成“this group”偏向“这个团体/小组”，意思有偏差，应译为“these people”或“this crowd”。

errors.span: I can't stand this group anymore.
errors.note: 口语字幕中“can't stand”偏书面，且“anymore”添加了原文没有的“再也受不了”的持续含义，语气略生硬。

m-036.translation: When I watch funny videos, I hold it in and don't dare laugh out loud.

m-033.translation: Brother B acts out that relatable student moment: listening attentively in class, then suddenly getting inexplicably irritated for no reason

errors.note: “b哥”是网络昵称/称呼，直译成“Brother B”生硬且不像英文观众熟悉的称呼，可考虑音译或保留“B”作为昵称。
“无名火”指莫名的怒气，译文“inexplicably irritated for no reason”语义重复（inexplicably 与 for no reason 同义），略显冗余，但不算误译。

m-039.translation: I heard Nestlé's making an indie film.

m-038.translation: I'd suggest you go through all of it—last year's test takers said a question "definitely wouldn't be on the exam," and it still showed up in the end.

m-041.translation: That's so random—what kind of new tactic is this?

m-040.translation: I can't even—this looks way too much like it.

errors.note: “I can't even—”是网络流行语，语气偏轻佻，与原文“我不行了”表达惊叹/招架不住的口语语气不完全对应，略显生硬。

errors.span: this looks way too much like it
errors.note: “像”指相似，译文用“looks like it”偏向“看起来像它”，语义略窄，但基本可理解。

m-043.translation: I'm dying—your contact name is cracking me up, that's so savage.

m-044.translation: This is way funnier than a Spring Festival Gala sketch.

m-047.translation: I want to start learning Python programming with absolutely no prior experience—where's the best place to start?

m-042.translation: Back in the day, I was riding high, playing my skill cards and raking in money from every direction. Now look at me—I've sunk to shining shoes here.

errors.note: “一手技能牌”是比喻性说法，指自己有一手好本领/技能，直译成“playing my skill cards”在英语中不自然，且丢失了“有一手好技能”的含义。

errors.span: raking in money from every direction
errors.note: “八方来财”是成语，指财源广进，译文意思基本对，但“from every direction”略显生硬，不够口语化。

m-045.translation: I can't handle this anymore—waking people up in the middle of the night is just too much.

m-046.translation: If you've got fleas, go take a bath. You made my phone reek.

errors.note: “骚哄的”指难闻的臭味（如跳蚤/体味），译文“reek”虽表臭味但丢失了“把我手机整的”这一使动含义，且“骚哄的”带有方言口语色彩，译文未体现。

m-048.translation: My blind date talked about her cat the whole time.

m-049.translation: As a new content creator, I've noticed my videos get decent views, but the comment section is always pretty dead.

m-051.translation: Quick, let me pinch myself to make sure I'm not dreaming.

m-053.translation: Work's been really stressful lately—I get so anxious I can't sleep. Any tips on how to cope?

m-050.translation: Remember, you don't need much equipment when you're just starting out—what matters is shooting more and practicing more.

m-052.translation: You're literally crying from panic—this place is colder than the cold palace.

errors.note: “你已急哭”是夸张/调侃的说法，意为“你急得都要哭了”，并非真的在哭；译成“literally crying”把比喻坐实，改变了原意。

errors.span: this place is colder than the cold palace
errors.note: “冷宫”是固定文化意象，直译为“cold palace”略显生硬，英文观众可能不解其“失宠幽禁之地”的含义。

m-054.translation: If it's all about luck, why does gear even matter?

m-056.translation: Guys, I'm still dead over here.

m-055.translation: During a dorm contraband check, a condom fell out from under my roommate's pillow.

errors.note: 原文“舍友”指室友，译文用“my roommate”可接受，但“舍友”与“我”的关系未明确；更关键的是原文未指明是“我的”舍友，译文添加了“my”这一所有格，属于增译，轻微改变视角。
原文“byt”是“避孕套”的拼音缩写/网络用语，译文直接译为“condom”语义正确，但丢失了原文口语化、隐晦缩写的语气，属于风格层面的轻微损失。

m-059.translation: Seeing a video of a delivery guy delivering food in the rain

m-058.translation: Post another update and I'll deal with you once I'm back in the country.

m-060.translation: The exam answers are on page 50 of the textbook.

m-062.translation: My feed is nothing but people posting "666" — it's honestly making my head spin.

m-057.translation: My mom said she wants to set me up with someone.

m-061.translation: I'm totally swooning over this move, what do I do girls?

m-063.translation: Help me cop the limited-edition sneakers.

m-066.translation: I can't understand a single word on the English listening exam.

m-065.translation: There's this guy in the next class who strikes a brooding pose in the mirror after class and claims he's the male lead of some drama.

m-064.translation: I have my teacher certification interview next week. Is there anything I should pay special attention to in the demo lesson part?

m-069.translation: What does this Moments post from my partner mean?

m-070.translation: I finally shared a meme I'd been saving up for a whole year in the group chat, and it totally fell flat.

m-067.translation: I'm dying, this is hilarious—the impression is so spot-on, it's basically a carbon copy of the original. Absolutely 10/10, not even trying to hide it. This one is a total drama queen.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是网络用语，意为“厉害/牛”，译成“10/10”改变了原意，属于误译。
“not even trying to hide it”基本传达了意思，但“装都不装了”更强调“连装都懒得装”，语气略有偏差。

m-068.translation: I can't take it anymore, ahhh! Listening to this is making my brain turn to mush.

m-072.translation: I can't handle this, it's way too intense.

m-071.translation: You're literally crying from panic—reply already, reply already!

errors.note: 原文没有“literally/字面上”之意，属于增译，轻微加强了语气。
重复“reply already”略显生硬，原文重复“马上回”是口语催促，译文可更自然，但不影响理解。

m-077.translation: Holy crap, this flavor is insane!

m-074.translation: Ideally somewhere that's great for photo ops and check-ins.

m-076.translation: You'll need: 200g cake flour, 100g butter, 60g powdered sugar, and 1 egg.

m-073.translation: Li Zongheng stars in a story about a father-in-law who loves to pull pranks, showing the Spring Festival fun of this generation of young people starting to take charge.

errors.note: “这届年轻人”是网络流行语，指当代年轻人，译成“this generation of young people”意思基本对，但略生硬，且“这届”的调侃语气有所流失。
“主持大局”译成“take charge”意思接近，但“主持大局”更强调在家庭/场合中主导、张罗，译文略显笼统，口语感不足。

m-078.translation: I'm already halfway through—I've got 50 slides done—and now you're telling me I might have to scrap it all and start over?

m-079.translation: How's the new character from this gacha?

m-075.translation: The "I want to check the cards" meme comes from a classic line by the French God of Gamblers in Stephen Chow's movie.

errors.note: 《法国赌神》是周星驰电影《赌侠》的片中角色/桥段，此处把“法国赌神”直译成 French God of Gamblers，容易被理解为一部法国电影或法国赌神本人，而非周星驰电影中的角色梗。
原文只说“周星驰电影”，未指明具体片名，译文可接受，但“法国赌神”与“周星驰电影”的关系被拆开，读者可能误以为台词出自一部法国电影。

m-085.translation: She'll probably laugh when she sees this meme, right?

m-080.translation: There's another one that works too.

errors.note: 原文“可以可以”只是重复强调“可以/行”，并未表达“也能用/也行”的意思，译文添加了“works too”这一原文没有的含义。
原文“还有一个”可理解为“还有一点/还有一句”，译文具体化为“another one”，语义略有偏移。

m-084.translation: I recommend doing 20 targeted practice questions a day—you'll see progress in a month.

m-083.translation: I can't even—this is way too cool!

m-081.translation: Has no one noticed how smart she is? She blew up by posting weird, absurd meme content to build her account, then switched to a pretty-girl looks-based style—giving her fans a huge contrast.

errors.note: “抽象”在此语境指抽象/荒诞的网络梗内容，译文加了“weird”并具体化为“meme content”，略有增译，但基本可接受。
“起号”指从零开始做账号/涨粉，译为“build her account”稍显笼统，未完全体现“起号”的起步含义。
表达生硬堆砌，不像自然口语字幕，可更简洁自然。

m-082.translation: I actually stayed to watch the Spring Festival Gala—this show is so good!

m-086.translation: My teammate's 0-10 and still bossing everyone around like crazy.

m-087.translation: I just finished a business plan—take a look and tell me what you think.

m-088.translation: I've been wanting to start doing yoga at home lately, but I'm a complete beginner and have no idea where to start.

m-090.translation: How to spot a cheater when playing cards

m-091.translation: Only something so abstract that no one can understand it counts as a real challenge.

m-095.translation: This joke is so funny it should be on national TV.

errors.note: “屏幕前的老铁们”是亲切的网络称呼，译成“Hey guys watching this”偏生硬、不够口语化，缺少“老铁”的亲近语气。

errors.note: “木灵”是网络用语/串子聚集的场所或群体，不是人名，与“牛子涵”并列为人名属于误译，会让观众误以为这是两个人。
“你已急哭”是网络梗，意为“你已经急得哭了/破防了”，译成“crying from panic”略偏，但基本可理解。

m-415.translation: 666, boss, take me under your wing!

errors.note: 中文网络用语“六百六十六”在字幕中直接保留为数字“666”，英文观众可能不理解其“厉害/牛”的含义，建议意译或加注。
“大佬”译为“boss”偏直译，口语字幕中“boss”易被理解为上司，语气与网络用语“大佬（高手/大神）”略有偏差。

m-417.translation: I've decided to start my diet tomorrow.

m-418.translation: I'm begging you, hahaha, don't check my homework!

errors.note: “怎么办”在此是表达无奈/好笑的自语，译成“What do I do”变成求助式提问，语气和含义偏差明显。

errors.span: What do I do, I want to laugh too.
errors.note: 两个独立句用逗号连接，标点不当，宜用句号或破折号。

m-420.translation: He's up in the sky, staring down at you all with a blank look—exactly the same.

errors.note: “失禁”意为失禁/大小便失控，并非“面无表情”，译文误译了核心词。
“看着”只是看，译文加了“staring down”的俯视/瞪视意味，属轻微增译。

m-421.translation: No way, come on, share some of that luck with me!

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为拒绝处对象/不谈恋爱，译成“No way”丢失了这层含义，变成单纯的惊讶或拒绝。
原文无对应内容，属增译，添加了催促语气。

m-423.translation: What on earth does "cabbage smiling at me" even mean?

m-424.translation: The Qing Dynasty's been gone for ages—and you're still pulling this workplace oppression crap?

m-428.translation: Sunshine Boy Huang Buliqiu teaches you how to use the new meme "As If I Care."

errors.note: “黄不溜秋”是描述性的绰号（意为“黄澄澄/黄得发亮”），音译成 Huang Buliqiu 丢失了含义，观众无法理解这个昵称。
“阳光男孩”直译略显生硬，作为网络昵称/字幕口语不够自然，但可理解。
“谁理你”译为 As If I Care 意思基本对应，但作为“新梗”名称通常应保留原梗说法或加引号说明，此处处理尚可；若该梗有固定英文说法则不一致。

m-433.translation: Just came across an insanely good new meme.

m-431.translation: The owner's wife let me in on their secret recipe.

errors.note: “老板娘”指女店主/女老板本人，而非“老板的妻子”，译文改变了人物身份。

m-432.translation: I just checked out a few new places that opened nearby—hot pot, BBQ, crayfish, they've got it all. I'm so torn.

m-434.translation: Why is everyone online saying 'yeah yeah' all the time now?

errors.note: “可以可以”表示认可/同意（“sure, sure”“okay okay”），译成“yeah yeah”改变了含义，且带有敷衍或不耐烦的语气。
原文是“网上这么多人”，即“so many people online”，而非“everyone online”，略微夸大了范围。

m-435.translation: That's such a classic move. My ex brushed me off the same way—even for important questions, they'd just reply with an emoji.

m-438.translation: Coach said to get yourself in the right mindset before the match.

m-437.translation: Why are you watching hot guy videos again?

m-436.translation: Nah, that's not the right way to do it.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不相处/不交往”，译成“Nah”（不）丢失了“不处”的具体含义，属于误译。

m-439.translation: Running into your boss in the elevator and not knowing whether or not to say hi.

m-440.translation: I want to start a new segment, but I don't know what to do it on.

m-443.translation: How should I reply to this?

m-441.translation: The two cities are a 2-hour direct high-speed rail ride apart. Remember to book a guesthouse in the old town in advance, and bring sunscreen and moisturizer.

m-444.translation: Say one more word and I'm gonna lose it.

m-442.translation: 666, there's a second level too—nostalgia overload!

errors.note: “爷青回”是网络用语，意为“我的青春回来了”，译文用“nostalgia overload”只传达了怀旧情绪，丢失了“青春回归”的核心含义。
中文网络用语“666”表示厉害、赞，直接保留数字对英文观众可能不易理解，宜译为“Awesome”等。

m-446.translation: My roommate games late at night and the keyboard clatter keeps me awake.

m-445.translation: You're already crying from the stress—if you don't buy it soon, I'm gonna actually cry.

errors.span: You're already crying from the stress
errors.note: “你已急哭”是夸张/调侃的说法，指对方着急到快哭，译文却译成对方真的因压力在哭，改变了意思。
“gonna actually cry”口语堆叠略生硬，且“actually”稍强化了语气，与原文“真的要哭了”基本对应但不够自然。

m-448.translation: It's best to pick one that includes in-home installation, so the elderly don't have to deal with the hassle themselves.

m-449.translation: The person I secretly have a crush on got together with someone else.

m-450.translation: Take it seriously—I'm writing this down.

m-452.translation: I really don't have time to fool around with you. It's totally normal for a girl to spend half an hour on makeup, okay?

m-447.translation: Call him a clean freak—he dries his socks and wears them again. Call him a slob—he at least knows to dry them first before wearing them again.

errors.note: “爱干净”只是讲卫生，译成“clean freak”（洁癖）语气过强，改变了原意。
“不爱干净”不等于“slob”（邋遢鬼），程度和贬义都被夸大。

errors.span: he at least knows to dry them first before wearing them again
errors.note: 原文“晾干了再穿”没有“first”所强调的先后对比，属于轻微增译。

m-451.translation: "So What? Who Cares?" — only when you say it all together does it become a real meme. Who else gets it?

errors.note: “谁懂”是网络用语，意为“谁能理解/有共鸣”，译成“Who else gets it?”（还有谁懂）改变了主语和语气，属于误译。

errors.span: only when you say it all together does it become a real meme
errors.note: “连起来”指把前后两部分连起来读，译文“say it all together”略显生硬，且“real meme”对应“真正的新梗”丢失了“新”的含义。

m-453.translation: Meanwhile, develop your own interests and don't rely too much on your partner.

m-454.translation: There are only 3 people watching the stream.

m-455.translation: Recently I've noticed that songs I like keep getting overused by short videos.

m-457.translation: The boss said we have to work overtime for a month straight.

m-456.translation: We're working through the night tonight—no arguments.

m-459.translation: You can split up the time—say, 10 minutes in the morning and 10 minutes in the evening.

m-458.translation: Bro, the final's tomorrow and you're not gonna let me copy off you?

m-461.translation: How would you describe a streamer openly asking a big spender for gifts?

errors.span: 一手操作打的那叫一个八面威风
errors.note: “八面威风”的威势/气势（威风凛凛、气势逼人）在译文中弱化为“legendary”，只保留了“厉害”之意，丢失了原文的气势感。

m-467.translation: I can't, this is way too embarrassing.

m-466.translation: The blogger acts out the "I wanna see your cards" meme.

errors.note: “acts out”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然的是“recreates”或“does”这类说法。
“窝要验牌”是带口音/玩梗的说法，意思是“我要验牌/查牌”，译成“see your cards”偏向“看你的牌”，丢失了“验牌/查牌”的含义。

m-471.translation: My roommate secretly watches funny videos under the covers at night, stifling their laughter.

m-469.translation: Remember, you're there to wish the couple well—looking presentable and appropriate is what matters most.

m-470.translation: That's a solid 666—the kind that just won't sink.

m-472.translation: The moves in this game are insane.

m-476.translation: 666, there's even a second level—this homage is a spot-on recreation!

m-485.translation: My bestie's showing off her boyfriend on Moments again.

m-495.translation: Any easy beginner recipes you'd recommend?

m-501.translation: It's too real and too absurd.

errors.note: “抽象”在网络口语中指离奇、难以理解或荒诞，译成“absurd”只覆盖了“荒诞”义，丢失了“过于真实又抽象”中“抽象”的特定网络语义，意思有明显偏差。

errors.note: “搞抽象”指网络抽象文化/荒诞梗，译成“absurd meme humor”基本达意，但“meme”是额外添加的具体化，原文未明确说梗图。

m-520.translation: My blind date suddenly played my ex's favorite song.

errors.note: 原文“前任最爱听的歌”指相亲对象的前任，译文“my ex's”却变成说话人自己的前任，指代错误。

m-522.translation: Why don't you go on a talent show?

errors.note: “Only you're still”读起来不自然；用“but you're still”或“yet you're still”更顺畅。

m-525.translation: Why do you keep watching such weird, random stuff every day? Watch something normal—your brain's gonna short-circuit. Hurry up and switch to something healthier.

errors.note: “抽象”在此口语语境中意为怪异/难以理解，译成“random”略有增译，但整体可接受。
“脑子瓦特了”是方言口语，指脑子坏掉/犯糊涂，译成“short-circuit”稍显生硬，但意思基本传达。

m-524.translation: I remember you saying just last week that you're socially anxious—what a turnaround!

errors.note: “反差也太大了吧”强调反差之大，译文“what a turnaround”只表示发生了转变，丢失了“太大”这一程度信息。
“社恐”是口语化网络用语，译成临床色彩的“socially anxious”略显生硬，不够口语化。

m-529.translation: A natural-born master of absurdity—seeing this straight-up short-circuited my brain.

m-531.translation: Fine, I'll deal with these paid troll comments once I'm back in China.

errors.note: 原文“腥骚色膻油”指五种气味/味道（腥、骚、色/膻、膻、油），译文把“色”误译为 lecherous（好色的），属于误译，改变了原意。

m-532.translation: The 100,000 Memes series showcases the 'read it, reply nonsense' memes with perfectly unhinged energy.

errors.note: “十万个梗库”是系列名称，直译为“100,000 Memes”会误导观众以为是一万个梗，而非系列名。
“精神状态良好”是反讽说法，译成“perfectly unhinged energy”改变了语气，原文的讽刺意味丢失。
“已读乱回”是网络梗，译文生硬直译，不像自然的字幕口语。

m-534.translation: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? I'm gonna go grab tickets right now!

m-533.translation: But doesn't anyone else think the word "annoying" is also super annoying? (I'm outta here, guess I'm just a total word-illiterate lol)

errors.note: “丈育”是网络用语，指“文盲”，直译成 word-illiterate 生硬不自然，英文口语里更常说 illiterate。
原文没有对应语气词，添加 lol 属于轻微增译，改变了字幕语气。

m-536.translation: I was already feeling bad, and laughing just made my stomach hurt even more.

errors.note: 原文“肚子更痛”指原本就有的肚子痛因笑而加剧，译文“made my stomach hurt even more”可理解为笑导致肚子痛加剧，但“stomach”偏指胃部，且“made my stomach hurt”暗示笑引起疼痛而非加重原有疼痛，语义有偏差。

errors.note: 英语口语中更自然的是“Why did you get your homework wrong again?”或“How come you got your homework wrong again?”，现译略显生硬。

errors.note: 句末状语位置生硬，英语习惯说 "this game" 前置或改为 "in this game"，读起来不自然。

errors.note: 中文网络用语“六百六十六”是“666”的谐音，表示“厉害/牛”，但英文“666”在西方语境中常与恶魔数字关联，直接照搬可能让观众误解语气，建议用“Insane”或“That's wild”等口语表达。

m-882.translation: Turns out when people say "you're already suffering" (yǐ jí kǔ), they actually mean "you're already crying from stress" (yǐ jí kū) — same sound, different words. Last time someone mocked me like that, I just fired back, "Bounce it right back at you!"

errors.note: 原文“你已疾苦”是谐音梗的谐音字面，译文用“suffering”虽对应“疾苦”，但未体现“已疾苦”作为被嘲讽的原话，且与后文“急哭”的谐音解释脱节，意思有偏差。
增译了原文没有的解释性内容，虽帮助理解谐音，但属于添加信息。

errors.span: Bounce it right back at you!
errors.note: “反弹”是网络用语，指把嘲讽/诅咒反弹回对方，译文“Bounce it right back at you”基本达意但偏直译，且“it”指代不明，语气不够口语化。

errors.note: “我不行了”是口语化的夸张感叹，直译成“I can't”在英语里显得生硬、语义不完整，不够像自然的字幕口语。

errors.note: “微光”是应用名，音译成 Weiguang 不如保留原名或使用官方英文名，观众可能无法对应。

errors.note: “this pointless formalities crap”中单数指示词 this 与复数名词 formalities 搭配不当，且 crap 与 formalities 混用造成语法/搭配错误，应改为“this pointless formality crap”或“these pointless formalities”。

errors.note: “之前就有了”只表示此前已存在，并未强调“很久/多年”，ages 略有程度夸大。
直译生硬，作为字幕口语不够自然，观众可能不易立即理解该梗。

errors.note: 原文“假装跳楼”是计划中的动作，译文用将来时“I'll fake”尚可，但“suicide jump”略显生硬，且“假装跳楼”未必是自杀，可能只是整蛊表演，语义稍有偏移。
